corpus.comparisonScope: 8组同中文字段的传统记录是探索性案例，不代表全体彝族音乐。

method.rmsDbReference: maximum RMS of this recording (0 dB); not calibrated loudness
method.pitchRangeDefinition: 12*log2(P95(F0)/P05(F0)), using all valid analysis frames before plot decimation
method.lowEnergyRatioDefinition: duration of contiguous below-threshold RMS intervals >=0.12s / decoded recording duration; includes leading/trailing regions
method.internalLowEnergyRatioDefinition: below-threshold interval duration within first-to-last above-threshold frame / that active-span duration
method.pairingDefinition: exact Unicode equality after .strip() on Chinese text among ecura IDs

duplicateAudit.limitation: Byte/decoded-PCM hashes detect identical files only; not near-duplicates or overlapping source excerpts.

limitations: pYIN为单基频估计，重叠人声、非周期音或录音噪声可能导致错误。
voicedProb是发声概率，不是音高正确率；未逐帧人工核验。
低能量区间是阈值派生，不能直接叫作停顿；音高缺失也不能当作静音。
无音节边界真值，不输出拖音时长、音节速率或情绪评分。
音频播放保留原文件；分析用单声道重采样版本。
中文可能是译文或摘要，同中文字段不保证相同彝语原词。
